name: D04_6_double_strike_ends_when_life_drops_below_25
notes: Printed: 'As long as you have 25 or more life, this creature has double strike.' Seat 0 has 25 life, so double strike is on. On the opponent's turn their 1/1 attacks unblocked: seat 0 loses 1 life (24), and the Paladin has no double strike any more. Losing life is not gaining life: no counter.
